meta.title: Tawjihi Hub | E-Learning Platform for Grade 12 Students
meta.description: A comprehensive educational platform for Academic and Vocational BTEC Tawjihi students. We offer comprehensive interactive classes, electronic exams, and continuous follow-up to ensure your excellence.

hero.badge: The #1 Platform Dedicated for Grade 12 in Jordan 🇯🇴
hero.subtitle: Choose your educational track (Academic or BTEC Vocational) and excel with Jordan's top educators, official Pearson syllabus guides, and our smart assessment engine.

tracks.title: Choose Your Grade 12 Pathway
tracks.subtitle: We strictly segregate user dashboards so you only view materials relevant to your chosen track.

tracks.academicDesc: Comprehensive academic track (Scientific, Literary) qualifying you for traditional university admission with advanced scientific curricula.
tracks.academicKeySubjects: Mathematics • Physics • Chemistry • Biology • Advanced English

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Our Vision & Mission at Tawjihi Hub
about.description: We are a leading educational platform aiming to revolutionize the way Academic and Vocational (BTEC) Tawjihi students learn in Jordan. We believe education should be interactive, engaging, and accessible to everyone at the highest quality standards.
about.missionDesc: To empower students by providing exceptional educational content, interactive classes, and continuous follow-up that ensures their excellence and helps them reach their academic goals with confidence.
about.visionDesc: To be the premier and most trusted destination for every Tawjihi student seeking excellence, innovating study methods that keep pace with modern requirements and ministry exams.
